text: make a website for my cousin's clothing boutique called Thread & Loom in Pune. it sells handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas. people should be able to browse products by category, filter by size and price, see a size guide, check new arrivals, and order on whatsapp. also show a lookbook section with styled outfits, the store timings and location, the return and exchange policy, and a few customer reviews. it should feel earthy and elegant and work well on phones

@Requester Your brief is clear on what the site should do. I need a few details only you can give, so nothing on the site is made up.
1. What WhatsApp number should customers use to order? Please include the country code.
2. What is the shop's full address in Pune, and what are the opening days and hours?
3. What are the return and exchange rules? For example, how many days customers have, and whether the item must be unworn or tagged.
4. Do you have the product names, prices, sizes, photos and a few real customer reviews to share?
   Option 1: Yes, I will share all of them (the site shows your real products and reviews)
   Option 2: I have some of them (the missing parts stay marked as not confirmed, and the site is not finished until you fill them in)
   Option 3: Not yet (the site is not finished until you share them)
